about: The Gönkor R-10 beyond its south stretch (tools/town/gonkor.py; M3 sprint 7, step 1; ISS-204): `lanes` its pieces in tools/terrain/pads.py's form, GK-<stretch>.<n> (E up the east side to the great wheel house's door, N on up round the north-east corner, behind the Labrang and down the north side round the wall's west end to the Gorge Stair's top, F along the face from the Gorge Stair's landing 23 to the 1,080 steps' forecourt, S from their landing 20 along the face to the south stretch's west end; `face` the face's pieces, `gallery` a timber gallery's deck), each `gonkor_way` its stretch; `loop` the way's points from the south stretch's east end round to its west end, as laid (anticlockwise: walk it backwards), with the Gorge Stair's last flight and the steps' last three that it walks; `stretches` what each found; `steps_gaps` the gaps in the 1,080 steps' landings' walls where it joins them (../tibet-blender export_lanes.py: [side, from, to]); `parapet_gaps` where it comes onto another way's landing, [its id, x0, y0, x1, y1]: that landing's parapet opened within a metre of the line (tools/town/walls.py); `marks` the places along it by name (x, y), for the routes. Regenerated with the terrain.
